The detector's own backtest verdict is blunt: on this market's history the absolute-trend gate did NOT help drawdown control (mean-reverting tape), momentum rank has weak/insignificant forward edge, and rotation timing is display-only. With gate_helps=false and a track record showing poor directional accuracy (0.373), any directional lean must be low conviction and framed as a falsifiable conditional.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only eligible, trend-tagged leader with the strongest durability bar (0.74) and wide breadth (0.833), so the prevailing narrative has cohesion and trend-health. However, this is a persistence/continuation lean on an already-crowded, one-narrative theme — NOT a return forecast. The crowding flag (z=1.72, crowded=true) is a size-down caution, not a reason to expect outperformance.
theses.dissent: This is a crowded, one-narrative leader on a mean-reverting tape where the trend gate has no historical drawdown edge; crowding/attention spikes in A-shares have frequently marked local tops, and poor dir_accuracy in the track record argues for humility.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is eligible with a moderate durability bar (0.57) and mixed trend health, but it is crowded (z=1.38) while ranked only 5th with a much lower score (0.375). In a narrow two-eligible-theme tape, it is the second eligible theme but shows no leadership edge; the crowding plus mixed hurst_tag argues for standing aside rather than chasing.
theses.dissent: As the only other eligible theme, a rotation away from overcrowded Banks could lift Pharma & CXO as a beneficiary of handoff; its mixed trend tag is not outright broken.
